rationale: C05 plausibly supplied a material core template for the child. Both orders declare an IEEPA national emergency based on the PRC's exploitation of United States investment to advance military, intelligence, security, and cyber capabilities; prohibit specified investment transactions by United States persons; delegate implementation and rulemaking to Treasury after interagency consultation; prohibit evasion and conspiracy; define covered persons and transactions; and authorize NEA/IEEPA reports to Congress. The child substantially expands and adapts that machinery from publicly traded securities of identified military companies to notifiable and prohibited outbound investments in specified sensitive-technology sectors. C18 is also highly relevant because it restates and broadens C05's securities-investment regime, but C05 contains the especially close originating factual and legal formulation. C07 supplies some parallel technology-risk regulatory machinery but concerns domestic acquisition and use of foreign ICTS rather than outbound investment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: countries of concern are exploiting or have the ability to exploit certain United States outbound investments... [to advance] military, intelligence, surveillance, or cyber-enabled capabilities
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the People's Republic of China (PRC) is increasingly exploiting United States capital to resource and to enable the development and modernization of its military, intelligence, and other security apparatuses
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared predicate: a foreign adversary exploits United States capital or investment to advance military and intelligence capabilities.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The regulations shall prohibit United States persons from engaging, directly or indirectly, in such transactions.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following actions are prohibited: ... any transaction in publicly traded securities ... of any Communist Chinese military company ... by any United States person
shared_material.explanation: Both use IEEPA to restrict investment transactions by United States persons in targeted PRC-linked enterprises; the child broadens the transaction and technology coverage.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Any conspiracy formed to violate any regulation issued under this order is prohibited... any action that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate... is prohibited.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Any transaction by a United States person or within the United States that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate the prohibitions set forth in this order is prohibited. Any conspiracy formed to violate any of the prohibitions set forth in this order is prohibited.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely reuses the parent's paired anti-evasion and anti-conspiracy provisions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary is authorized to take such actions and to employ all powers granted to the President by IEEPA as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this order... [and] may redelegate any functions... within the Department of the Treasury.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of the Treasury... is hereby authorized to take such actions, including the promulgation of rules and regulations, and to employ all powers granted to the President by IEEPA, to carry out the purposes of this order... [and] may... redelegate any of these functions within the Department of the Treasury.
shared_material.explanation: The child adopts the same Treasury-centered IEEPA implementation and internal-redelegation machinery.
